lines: Bakul Hiralal Shah, an Investor Selling Shareholder, may sell up to 12,600 shares in the offer for sale, with proceeds up to ₹1.70 crore if all offered shares are sold; the offer price is ₹1,352 and actual proceeds may be slightly lower due to the employee-portion discount.
Timing is at listing, with trading start printed as March 11, 2026, which makes this a timely call as the sale and liquidity window is now.
Gain is up to ₹1.26 crore before offer expenses and taxes, and retained holding is an estimate of ₹3.97 crore valued at offer price.
Family link: Bakul shares the surname Shah and middle name Hiralal with Atul Hiralal Shah. Confidence is medium because the holding was found in only one section (promoter_holding).
